CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, email, phone, role, level)
  values (
    new.id,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 'New Member'),
    new.email,
    new.phone,
    'member',
    'Level 1'
  );
  return new;
end;
$function$
